subject.title: [codex] Verify Telegram topic proof for cron delivery

question: Should OpenClaw accept `validateDeliveryResults` as a plugin-facing post-send SDK hook and use it for fail-closed Telegram non-General topic proof once the progress-proof blocker is fixed?
rationale: The mechanical proof propagation bug can be repaired, but the permanent SDK surface and after-send fail-closed semantics are compatibility and plugin-contract choices that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof repair
options.body: Keep the generic hook, require the progress/final proof propagation fix and regression tests, then treat Telegram topic proof validation as the owner-boundary implementation.

options.title: Keep validation Telegram-internal
options.body: Remove the plugin SDK hook and implement the topic proof check inside Telegram-only delivery code if maintainers do not want a new third-party adapter contract.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Hold or close the PR if the fail-closed after-send behavior is not an acceptable upgrade tradeoff for current Telegram topic jobs.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof repair
recommendation.body: Keep the generic hook, require the progress/final proof propagation fix and regression tests, then treat Telegram topic proof validation as the owner-boundary implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent Telegram topic-routing and plugin-boundary history most directly related to the SDK/fail-closed decision.
